Rubbish collected by Baltimore's Trash Wheels

trash_collections.Rd

Dumpster collections from four Trash Wheels operating in Baltimore's waterways: Mister, Professor, Captain and Gwynnda. Each row describes one rubbish type in one dumpster collection, so each collection appears seven times. Item counts are estimates based on samples taken during collection. A missing count means the rubbish type was not recorded for that collection; it does not mean that no items were collected.

Usage

trash_collections

Format

A data frame with 6,951 rows and 11 variables:

id

Short identifier for the Trash Wheel.

name

Name of the Trash Wheel.

dumpster

Dumpster collection number for that wheel.

month

Month of collection.

year

Year of collection.

date

Date of collection.

weight

Weight of collected rubbish, in US tons.

volume

Volume of collected rubbish, in cubic yards.

homes_powered

Source estimate of the number of homes that could be powered using energy generated from the collected rubbish.

trash_type

Type of rubbish counted: Plastic Bottles, Polystyrene, Cigarette Butts, Glass Bottles, Plastic Bags, Wrappers or Sports Balls.

count

Estimated number of items of that type in the collection; missing when the type was not recorded.

Source

TidyTuesday, Trash Wheel Collection Data (2024-03-05), https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/main/data/2024/2024-03-05; original data from Baltimore's Healthy Harbor initiative, https://www.mrtrashwheel.com/.

Details

weight, volume and homes_powered describe the whole collection, so they repeat on each of its seven rows. Do not add them up across rubbish types. The wheels began operating in different years (Mister 2014, Professor 2017, Captain 2018, Gwynnda 2021), and not every wheel records every rubbish type.
